items.title: adjustInventoryLevelsStep
items.description:
This step adjusts the stocked quantity of one or more inventory levels. You can
pass a positive value in `adjustment` to add to the stocked quantity, or a negative value to
subtract from the stocked quantity.

items.title: attachInventoryItemToVariants
items.description: This step creates one or more links between variant and inventory item records.

items.title: createInventoryItemsStep
items.description: This step creates one or more inventory items.

items.title: createInventoryLevelsStep
items.description: This step creates one or more inventory levels.

items.title: deleteInventoryItemStep
items.description: This step deletes one or more inventory items.

items.title: deleteInventoryLevelsStep
items.description: This step deletes one or more inventory levels.

items.title: updateInventoryItemsStep
items.description: This step updates one or more inventory items.

items.title: updateInventoryLevelsStep
items.description: This step updates one or more inventory levels.

items.title: validateInventoryLocationsStep
items.description:
This step ensures that the inventory levels exist for each
specified pair of inventory item and location. If not,
the step will throw an error.

items.title: validateInventoryItemsForCreate
items.description:
This step checks whether a variant already has an inventory item.
If so, the step will throw an error.
